best_for: Owners of a recent Logitech MX, Lift, Signature, POP or Pebble mouse or keyboard who want per-app buttons, gestures and shortcuts on Windows or Mac.

points.title: Buttons that change per app
points.text: You can give mouse buttons and keys different jobs in Chrome, Word, Zoom, Photoshop and other apps. Smart Actions chain several steps onto one press, much like a macro.

points.title: Flow across computers
points.text: Logitech Flow moves your pointer, text and files between computers, even across Windows and macOS. All machines must be on the same Wi-Fi network or subnet, and Flow relies on Logitech cloud services.

points.title: Replaces Logitech Options
points.text: The older Logi Options app has reached end of support. Supported devices moved to Options+, and you can bring settings across from Options 8.54 or later.

points.title: Account for cloud features
points.text: A Logi ID is needed for settings backup and restore. An offline installer exists for closed networks, but it drops Logi ID sign-in, backup, Flow, Smart Actions and Logi Voice.

points.title: No Linux version
points.text: On Linux, basic mouse and keyboard functions work, but button customization needs Windows 10 (version 1903 or later), macOS, Googlebook OS or iPadOS. Logitech's pages differ on the macOS minimum, listing 13 in one place and 14 in another.

points.title: Versions kept here
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 2 versions of the machine-wide installer, and macOS lists one universal build, so there is little room to roll back here.
